title: Another American citizen has been killed by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). 👿
text:
Another American citizen has been killed by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). 👿 "

"During an operation to arrest an immigrant, ICE officers suspected Bastian Guerrero and fatally shot him. It was later confirmed, however, that he was actually a U.S. citizen. Video footage shows officers handcuffing him *after* pulling his body out of the vehicle."

"This marks the second time in just six days that ICE has killed a citizen during its large-scale arrest sweeps.
